**3c.** `_getWeekLookahead` (current lines 1241-1266) — full replacement:

```dart
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _getWeekLookahead() {
    const dayNames = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
    final today = istTodayStr();
    // ActiveWorkoutPersistence never persists a DATE (checked
    // active_workout_persistence.dart in full) — its mere presence means
    // TODAY has a live in-progress session. Narrower than the Riverpod
    // inProgressDateOf this file cannot reach (plain class, no Ref), but
    // sufficient for a display-only hint (spec §5.8 — this is not the
    // engine's own gate, which re-checks everything at apply time).
    final inProgressDate =
        ActiveWorkoutPersistence.readState() != null ? today : null;
    final weekStateCache = <String, List<DaySwapDayState>>{};
    List<DaySwapDayState> statesFor(String date) => weekStateCache.putIfAbsent(
        DaySwapRules.mondayOf(date),
        () => SwapService.instance
            .weekStates(date, inProgressDate: inProgressDate));

    final results = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      final date = DateTime.now().add(Duration(days: i));
      final dateStr = istDateStr(date);
      final dayLabel = dayNames[(istDateOf(date).weekday - 1) % 7];
      final rawSchedule = _hive.workoutBox.get('schedule_$dateStr');
      final row =
          rawSchedule is Map ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawSchedule) : null;
      final state = statesFor(dateStr).firstWhere(
          (d) => d.date == dateStr,
          orElse: () => DaySwapDayState(
              date: dateStr,
              row: row,
              lock: DaySwapRefusal.noRow,
              isMoved: false,
              title: ''));
      final entry = <String, dynamic>{
        'day': dayLabel,
        'date': dateStr,
        'type':
            row != null ? (row['type'] ?? row['workout_name'] ?? 'UNKNOWN') as String : 'REST',
        'status': row != null ? (row['status'] ?? 'pending') as String : 'rest',
        'name': row != null ? DaySwapCopy.titleOf(row) : DaySwapCopy.restDay,
        'can_swap': state.movable,
        'week_start': DaySwapRules.mondayOf(dateStr),
      };
      if (!state.movable && state.lock != null) {
        entry['swap_block'] = state.lock!.code;
      }
      results.add(entry);
    }
    return results;
  }

  /// Top-level `swaps_left` map — `{<IST Monday>: <swaps left>}` for every
  /// week [_getWeekLookahead] touches (spec §5.8:535 — the SoT for this key's
  /// name; a coordinator-dispatch text calling it `day_swaps` was drift,
  /// corrected 2026-09-27). Recomputes the date range independently rather
  /// than threading `_getWeekLookahead`'s own output
  /// through the snapshot literal (design decision 4).
  Map<String, int> _getSwapsLeftForLookahead() {
    final isPro = SubscriptionService.instance.isPro();
    final weekStarts = <String>{};
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      weekStarts.add(DaySwapRules.mondayOf(
          istDateStr(DateTime.now().add(Duration(days: i)))));
    }
    return {
      for (final w in weekStarts)
        w: DaySwapAllowance.instance.current(w, isPro: isPro).left,
    };
  }
```

  EMPTY), leaves Fri as the base workout, and turns Sat into rest; swapping Fri↔Sat makes Fri
  rest (inheriting Sat's content) while Sat stays non-rest (inheriting Fri's), producing a FRESH
  Wed-Thu-Fri 3-run with none of its dates in the empty `beforeSet` — deterministically flagged.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the registry entries**

#### 1a. New concept: `sync_skip_index` (the shared helper)

```yaml
  - concept: sync_skip_index
    domain: sync_infra
    description: |
      Day-swapper + sync-load batch (Task 4, spec §5.9, plan D4/D13): the ONE
      generic skip-index helper every per-domain sync method (14 domains, plus
      the two pre-existing H1b-pattern domains sched/exlog/nlog which keep
      their own bespoke pure statics) now calls instead of hand-rolling a
      fingerprint map. `SyncSkipDomain` is the enum of every domain that owns
      a reserved `sync_<domain>_payload_hash_index` Hive key and a
      `disable_<domain>_hash_skip` kill switch — see the 14 sibling concepts
      below for the per-domain instances. `SyncFingerprint.of(payload)` is the
      canonical-JSON UUID-v5 fingerprint function every domain's inline
      closure calls (no more per-domain named pure statics like the
      pre-existing `exlogPayloadFingerprint`). `SyncSkipIndex.clearAll` is the
      SINGLE call `simulation_service.dart`'s `resetJourney` now makes to wipe
      every domain's index in one pass, replacing the N per-domain literal
      clears the pre-existing sched/exlog/nlog concepts each needed
      individually.
    writers:
      - file: lib/core/services/sync/sync_skip_index.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: SyncSkipIndex (pushIfChanged, commit, recordConfirmed, clearAll — whole class)
      - file: lib/features/dev/simulation_service.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: resetJourney (calls SyncSkipIndex.clearAll once for every SyncSkipBox)
    reader_manifest_complete: true
    readers:
      - file: lib/core/services/sync/sync_skip_index.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: SyncSkipIndex.readIndex
        semantic: latest
        fields_read: [box.get(domain.indexKey)]
        notes: |
          Reader and writer are the SAME class operating on the SAME reserved
          key inside one call — structurally impossible to drift, same
          argument the pre-existing sched/exlog/nlog concepts already make.
    hive:
      box: workoutBox | nutritionBox | healthBox | customBox  # per-domain, see SyncSkipBox enum
      key_prefix: ""
      key_formula: "one reserved key per SyncSkipDomain value: domain.indexKey (e.g. 'sync_wlog_payload_hash_index'); see the 14 sibling concepts for the concrete keys"
    behavioral_test_path: test/sync/sync_skip_index_test.dart
    class_constraints: |
      Fingerprint is a THUNK evaluated inside the helper's try (a throwing
      fingerprint fails open: push, don't record). push() returning false
      records nothing (unconfirmed, not a failure). A thrown or unconfirmed
      push DROPS any previously-stored fingerprint for that row (closes
      OI-204's edit-then-revert residue). Only the FIRST failure per pass per
      domain is reported (D13) — sub-writes inside a bundle report under the
      domain's own opType. The owner check runs before every push AND before
      recording; once the account changes mid-pass the pass is `aborted` and
      commit() writes nothing. `disabled` (kill switch) pushes everything,
      records nothing, and commit() DELETES the stored index.
```

Notes: Gate 9 does not fire on this concept — `key_prefix: ""` (matches the gate's own carve-out
for non-Hive-backed / not-a-single-prefix concepts, same pattern `typography_canonical_source`
uses). Gate 42 is satisfied by the real `test/sync/sync_skip_index_test.dart` behavioral suite
(confirmed created by Task 4, `tasks_w0b.md:10`).

#### 1b. Fourteen per-domain `*_payload_hash_index` concepts

One shared template, instantiated per domain from `brief_sync.md`'s table (concept names copied
verbatim from that table — never the short Hive-key form). All 14 share: `domain:` = the feature
area; a single `writers:` entry (the domain's sync method, which constructs a `SyncSkipIndex` for
`SyncSkipDomain.<x>` and calls `SyncFingerprint.of(payload)` inline — no per-domain named pure
fingerprint function exists post-Task-4, unlike the pre-existing sched/exlog/nlog concepts) plus
the kill-switch getter in `sync_service.dart`; a single `readers:` entry (same method, reading its
own index via `SyncSkipIndex`/`index.aborted` before deciding to push); `reader_manifest_complete:
true` (see the Gate-50 note above); `sync_methods: [<the one method>]`; `restore_methods: []`.

```yaml
    restore_methods: []
    class_constraints: |
      created_at is NEVER DateTime.now() at push time — read from the local
      template row's own created_at (plan D2 fix). The id-resolution SELECT
      that finds rows to tail-vacuum runs unconditionally, outside the skip
      decision (it is not itself a mutating upsert).

  - concept: sync_workout_plan_payload_hash_index
    domain: workout
    description: |
      Day-swapper + sync-load Task 20 (spec §5.9, §5.11, §5.10 rule 3):
      SyncSkipIndex for SyncSkipDomain.plan, gating _syncWorkoutPlan's
      re-upload of the whole plan bundle. Row key is the single reserved
      constant kPlanBundleRowKey = 'bundle' (one plan per user, not a
      per-date/per-id map). Fingerprint excludes synced_at.

      ALIAS NOTE (spec §8 also names this same stored value
      `plan_bundle_cloud_fingerprint` — Task 20/22's own comments and Task
      22's restore-merge L2 skip both use that name): this is the SAME Hive
      slot as this concept, NOT a second concept. `plan_bundle_cloud_fingerprint`
      is the value found at
      `SyncSkipIndex.readIndex(HiveService.instance.workoutBox,
      SyncSkipDomain.plan.indexKey)[kPlanBundleRowKey]` — i.e. this concept's
      own stored fingerprint, read by a SECOND caller (Task 22's restore-merge
      L2, `plan_integrity_reconciler.dart` / `sync_workout.dart`'s
      `_restoreWorkoutPlan`) to skip an unchanged incoming bundle merge
      entirely, in addition to this concept's own writer/reader skipping the
      unchanged OUTGOING push. One store, two directions of skip decision, one
      registry entry. Task 22 explicitly does NOT add a second Gate-9 file for
      `plan_bundle_cloud_fingerprint` (draft_task_22.md: "no new Gate 9
      writer_to_reader_test.dart file -- plan_bundle_cloud_fingerprint is
      already [covered]").
    writers:
      - file: lib/core/services/sync/sync_workout.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: _syncWorkoutPlan (SyncSkipIndex for SyncSkipDomain.plan, row key kPlanBundleRowKey)
      - file: lib/core/services/sync_service.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "_planHashSkipDisabled getter (disable_plan_hash_skip kill switch)"
    reader_manifest_complete: true
    readers:
      - file: lib/core/services/sync/sync_workout.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: _syncWorkoutPlan (outgoing-push skip decision reads index[kPlanBundleRowKey])
        semantic: latest
        fields_read: [sync_plan_payload_hash_index.bundle]
      - file: lib/core/services/plan_integrity_reconciler.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "restore-merge L2 skip (Task 22) -- reads the SAME stored fingerprint (aka plan_bundle_cloud_fingerprint) to skip merging an unchanged incoming bundle"
        semantic: flag-check
        fields_read: [sync_plan_payload_hash_index.bundle]
      - file: lib/core/services/sync/sync_workout.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "_restoreWorkoutPlan (Task 22) -- same L2 skip read, alternate call site"
        semantic: flag-check
        fields_read: [sync_plan_payload_hash_index.bundle]
    regression_test: test/contracts/sync_workout_plan_payload_hash_index_writer_to_reader_test.dart
    behavioral_test_path: test/contracts/sync_workout_plan_payload_hash_index_writer_to_reader_test.dart
    hive:
      box: workoutBox
      key_prefix: "sync_plan_payload_hash_index"
      key_formula: "reserved single key -> Map{'bundle' (kPlanBundleRowKey): SyncFingerprint.of(planBundle)}"
    cloud:
      table: user_progress
      columns: [user_id, plan_json, sync_epoch]
      unique_constraint: "(user_id)"
    sync_methods: [_syncWorkoutPlan]
    restore_methods: [_restoreWorkoutPlan]
    class_constraints: |
      One row per user (no per-date map). L2 (Task 22) is a SEPARATE kill
      switch from this concept's own outgoing-push skip (CLAUDE.md §4.6 —
      spec sec 5.7 names exactly one kill switch for L2; this concept's own
      disable_plan_hash_skip is a second, independent one for the push side).
```

#### 1c. New concept: `day_swap_engine`

```yaml
  - concept: day_swap_engine
    domain: workout
    description: |
      Day-swapper + sync-load Task 11 (spec §5.5, §5.6): the rebuilt
      SwapService.swapDays + weekStates + preview -- the ONLY place that
      moves the CONTENT (exercises/workout_name/type) of two schedule_<date>
      rows between each other, stamps `arranged_at_ms` on both rows (see the
      sibling `schedule_arrangement_stamp` concept below, which documents
      that field's own writer/reader contract), backs up a displaced day to
      `displaced_<date>` when applicable, and clears the MOVED flag on a
      swap-back. Consumes `DayAllowance`/`DaySwapAllowance` (sibling concept
      `day_swap_allowance`) to gate the weekly limit and `DaySwapRules`
      (pure, no Hive) for refusal classification. Replaces the pre-existing
      `swap_counters` concept's swapDays implementation in place (same class,
      same file, rewritten body) -- see that concept's entry below for the
      retirement note.
    writers:
      - file: lib/core/services/swap_service.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "SwapService.swapDays (builds both schedule_<date> rows -- content + a fresh arranged_at_ms -- and both displaced_<date> backups, then hands them to WorkoutWriteService.swapScheduledDays for the atomic write)"
      - file: lib/core/services/workout_write_service.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "swapScheduledDays (plan Task 6, :648-721 at plan-drafting time -- the actual two-date-lock atomic Hive write; writes all four keys or none; a completed live row is never moved; fires the ONE syncWorkoutData()/pushSnapshot() pair already covered by sync_fanout_workout_domain's whole-file WorkoutWriteService reader row)"
      - file: lib/core/services/day_swap/day_swap_allowance.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "DaySwapAllowance.consume (called from swapDays on a confirmed swap; see day_swap_allowance concept)"
    reader_manifest_complete: false
    readers:
      - file: lib/features/train/widgets/swap_picker_sheet.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "SwapPickerSheet (Task 24, U5; shared by Train ⇅ and Home long-press) -- reads daySwapWeekProvider/daySwapAllowanceProvider, never schedule_<date> directly"
        semantic: pass-through

      - file: lib/features/train/widgets/swap_confirm_sheet.dart
        line_range: 1-9999

        semantic: pass-through

      - file: lib/features/train/screens/train/week_rows.dart
        line_range: 1-9999

        semantic: pass-through

        semantic: pass-through

      - file: supabase/functions/_shared/tools/workout/swapWorkoutDays.ts
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "AI-coach swapWorkoutDays tool (Task 27, U6) -- server-side derive-only pin, does not call SwapService directly (Dart vs Deno); the ACTUAL Hive write happens client-side after the coach's confirm card is accepted, via the SAME SwapService.swapDays path as the picker"
        semantic: pass-through
        fields_read: [confirm-card acceptance -> client calls SwapService.instance.swapDays(origin: DaySwapOrigin.coach)]
    reader_allow_files:
      - { file: lib/features/home/widgets/swap_sheet.dart, reason: "Task 11 adapts this call site to the new API so the tree keeps compiling between U4 and U5's landing; Task 26 deletes the file entirely." }
    hive_storage:
      box: workoutBox
      keys: ["schedule_<date> (exercises/workout_name/type/arranged_at_ms fields)", "displaced_<date>"]
    behavioral_test_path: test/services/day_swap/day_swap_engine_test.dart

      - { pattern: "WorkoutScheduleService\\.instance\\.swapDays", reason: "Retired API (pre-existing swap_counters concept); use SwapService.instance.swapDays / the day_swap_provider Riverpod layer." }

      Refuses (DaySwapRefusal) rather than throws on: same day, different
      week, past date, no schedule row, completed/started/paused/travel/
      rescheduled/skipped lock, or allowance spent. Refuses if it would
      create a 3+ consecutive rest-day run (RestRunWarning surfaces a
```

Note: `reader_manifest_complete: false` here is deliberate, not an oversight — see Gate-50 caveat
in the preamble above and Unverified claims. `day_swap_engine` has NO `hive.key_prefix` (it
writes existing `schedule_`/`displaced_` keys owned by `scheduled_workouts_mutations`, not a new
prefix of its own), so Gate 50's phase-2 exhaustive check does not fire on it regardless of the
`reader_manifest_complete` value — set to `false` anyway per the stated policy of not claiming
exhaustiveness I have not personally re-verified post-integration. Gate 9 does not require a
contract test for it either (no non-empty `key_prefix:`); the `behavioral_test_path` above is
required by Gate 42 and is satisfied by Task 11's real `test/services/day_swap/day_swap_engine_test.dart`.

#### 1d. New concept: `day_swap_allowance`

```yaml
  - concept: day_swap_allowance
    domain: workout
    description: |
      Day-swapper + sync-load Task 11 (spec §5.3, plan Decided cross-task
      contracts): the phone-local weekly swap counter (free 1 / PRO 3 per
      IST Monday-Sunday week), replacing the pre-existing swap_counters
      concept's swap_week_start/swaps_this_week keys with a single Hive map
      keyed by IST week-start. Reconciled against the SERVER-side quota
      ledger via consume-day-swap (Task 8) at confirm time -- see
      usage_quota_ledger's day_swap reader entry below; the two counters are
      independent (Hive is optimistic/local, the server call is the
      authoritative per-account-wide cap across devices) and Task 11's
      swapDays only commits the local increment after treating any non-200
      server response as "keep the phone copy" per brief_common.md's decided
      contract.
    writers:
      - file: lib/core/services/day_swap/day_swap_allowance.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: DaySwapAllowance.consume
    reader_manifest_complete: true
    readers:
      - file: lib/core/services/day_swap/day_swap_allowance.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: DaySwapAllowance.current
        semantic: latest
        fields_read: [DaySwapAllowance.hiveKey.<weekStart>.used, .limit]
      - file: lib/core/services/swap_service.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "SwapService.swapDays / preview (reads DaySwapAllowance.current to compute DaySwapPreview.allowance and to refuse on spent)"
        semantic: flag-check
        fields_read: [DaySwapAllowance.current(weekStart)]
    regression_test: test/contracts/day_swap_allowance_writer_to_reader_test.dart
    behavioral_test_path: test/contracts/day_swap_allowance_writer_to_reader_test.dart
    hive:
      box: userBox
      key_prefix: ""
      key_formula: "DaySwapAllowance.hiveKey (single reserved key) -> Map{weekStart: {used: int, limit: int}}"
    telemetry_op_types:
      success: [day_swap_done]
      failure: [day_swap_refused, day_swap_failed]
      non_fatal: [day_swap_allowance_consume]
    class_constraints: |
      Telemetry op types are emitted at CONFIRM time only, never from
      preview()/weekStates() (spec §5.5). A week with no stored row reads as
      used=0 (fresh allowance). Kill-switch-free by design (spec does not
      name one for this concept — the local counter degrading to "always
      allow" on a bug would only ever UNDER-restrict, never brick the
      feature, so no separate disable flag was specified).
```

Note: `key_prefix: ""` on the `hive:` block is deliberate — `DaySwapAllowance.hiveKey` is a single
literal constant, not a prefix family, matching the same convention `swap_counters`'s pre-existing
`hive_storage:` block already uses for its own single-key state (that concept uses
`hive_storage:`/`keys:` instead of `hive:`/`key_prefix:` for exactly this reason — a set of plain
keys, not a prefix). I used `hive:`/`key_prefix: ""` here instead of `hive_storage:` because Gate
9's regex explicitly treats `""` under either spelling as "not Hive-backed" — no gate behavior
differs between the two spellings for a single reserved key; `test/contracts/day_swap_allowance_writer_to_reader_test.dart`
is created directly by Task 11 regardless of whether Gate 9 would have required it, so this is
belt-and-suspenders, not gate-driven.

#### 1e. New concept: `schedule_arrangement_stamp`

```yaml
  - concept: schedule_arrangement_stamp
    domain: workout
    description: |
      Day-swapper + sync-load Task 11/21 (spec §5.6, §5.7): the `arranged_at_ms`
      field stamped onto a `schedule_<date>` Hive row by SwapService.swapDays
      every time that row's content changes via a swap (whichever side of the
      pair; both sides get a fresh stamp). Read by Task 21's restore-merge L1
      (`PlanIntegrityReconciler.mergeScheduleEntry`) and L3 conflict logic to
      decide which side (local vs a snapshot/incoming cloud row) is the more
      recently arranged one for a given IST week -- the merge favors the
      HIGHER arranged_at_ms per date; a missing value on either side counts
      as 0. This is a NEW field on an EXISTING concept's storage
      (`scheduled_workouts_mutations` owns `schedule_<date>` as a whole), so
      it gets its own concept entry rather than being folded into that
      entry's already-large writer/reader lists, per the same reasoning the
      existing registry uses for other single-field sub-contracts.
    writers:
      - file: lib/core/services/swap_service.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: SwapService.swapDays (DECIDES the value -- stamps arranged_at_ms on both affected schedule_<date> rows on every content-swapping call, including swap-back)
      - file: lib/core/services/workout_write_service.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "swapScheduledDays (plan Task 6, :648-721 at plan-drafting time -- performs the actual atomic Hive PUT of the arranged_at_ms value SwapService.swapDays decided)"
      - file: lib/core/services/workout_write_service.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "upsertScheduled carry-forward rule (plan Task 6, :574-646 at plan-drafting time -- a SECOND, independent writer: carries an EXISTING arranged_at_ms forward onto a regenerated/rescheduled entry that has none, when WriteSource is neither daySwap nor restore)"
    reader_manifest_complete: true
    readers:
      - file: lib/core/services/plan_integrity_reconciler.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: mergeScheduleEntry
        semantic: max
        fields_read: [schedule_<date>.arranged_at_ms]
        notes: "missing arranged_at_ms counts as 0 (tasks_u4_t11.md / draft_task_21.md fixture: 'missing arranged_at_ms counts as 0: an unstamped local week loses')"
      - file: lib/core/services/sync/sync_workout.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "_restoreWorkoutPlan's schedule loop (Task 21 L3)"
        semantic: max
        fields_read: [schedule_<date>.arranged_at_ms]
    regression_test: test/sync/restore_merge_l1_l3_test.dart
    behavioral_test_path: test/sync/restore_merge_l1_l3_test.dart
    hive:
      box: workoutBox
      key_prefix: ""
      key_formula: "schedule_<date>['arranged_at_ms'] (int, epoch ms) -- a FIELD inside the existing schedule_<date> row, not a new top-level key"
    class_constraints: |
      Swap-back (undo) KEEPS the newer arranged_at_ms rather than clearing it
      to the pre-swap value (tasks_u4_t11.md:415-423) -- an arrangement stamp
      only ever moves forward in time. The merge treats a missing stamp as 0,
      never as "infinitely old" or a merge-abort condition.
```

#### 1f. New concept: `sync_epoch`

```yaml
  - concept: sync_epoch
    domain: sync_infra
    description: |
      Day-swapper + sync-load Task 20 (spec §5.10 rule 3, §5.11): a cloud-side
      monotonic counter on `user_progress.sync_epoch` (added by migration 145,
      Task 7/U1 — column does not exist before that migration lands; a
      pre-migration row reads as epoch 0) that lets `restoreLightweightAlways`
      detect "something changed server-side hard enough that every domain
      skip-index should be invalidated" (e.g. an admin-side repair, the Task
      23 hybrid repair migrator) without walking every domain individually.
      Local high-water mark is `configBox['sync_epoch_seen']`
      (`SyncService.kSyncEpochSeenKey`). On first sight (no `sync_epoch_seen`
      key at all) the baseline is stored WITHOUT clearing anything. When the
      cloud epoch is strictly greater than the stored `sync_epoch_seen`,
      `SyncSkipIndex.clearAll(...)` runs for every domain and the new epoch
      is stored. A cloud epoch <= the stored value is a no-op. A missing
      `sync_epoch` column/value (pre-migration-145 or older DB state) reads
      as 0 and is treated as a no-op the same way.
    writers:
      - file: lib/core/services/sync_service.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "restoreLightweightAlways's sync_epoch resync lever (reads the shared user_progress select, writes configBox['sync_epoch_seen'])"
    reader_manifest_complete: true
    readers:
      - file: lib/core/services/sync_service.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: restoreLightweightAlways
        semantic: latest
        fields_read: [configBox.sync_epoch_seen, cloud user_progress.sync_epoch]
    regression_test: test/sync/restore_lightweight_single_plan_fetch_test.dart
    behavioral_test_path: test/sync/restore_lightweight_single_plan_fetch_test.dart
    hive:
      box: configBox
      key_prefix: ""
      key_formula: "'sync_epoch_seen' (single reserved key, int)"
    cloud:
      table: user_progress
      columns: [user_id, plan_json, sync_epoch]
      unique_constraint: "(user_id)"
    class_constraints: |
      The kill switch is `disable_restore_single_plan_fetch` (shared with
      Task 20's single-launch-fetch optimization, per CLAUDE.md §4.6's
      "one kill switch per story" note applied here — this is the SAME flag,
      not a second one for sync_epoch alone; see the sync_workout_plan_payload_hash_index
      entry's class_constraints for the reasoning this is deliberately not
      split further). A missing sync_epoch column/value reads as 0, never as
      an error or a forced full-clear. NEVER add `disable_restore_single_plan_fetch`
      (or any other legitimate kill-switch name) as a `forbidden_legacy_patterns:`
      entry — Gate 50 Phase 1 has no allowlist for a pattern's own definition
      site, so naming a real flag there fails the gate on its own legitimate
      check-sites, not just misuse.
```

#### Late addition: `restore_type_derivation` (found via `draft_task_23.md`'s handoff note, added
after the coordinator's mid-task correction below)

`draft_task_23.md` and `draft_task_27_28.md` both appeared in the scratchpad partway through this
session (absent at the 10-minute mark, present by the time this draft was finalized). Re-checking
them surfaced one thing brief_t29.md's own scope list did NOT name: `draft_task_23.md:972-977`
explicitly hands Task 29 a NEW concept, `restore_type_derivation`, sourced from
`docs/diagnoses/2026-09-26-restore-types-rest-days-as-workouts-b6e1c8.md`, whose frontmatter is
already a complete, filled-in `diagnose_stanza`-shaped block (read in full from the repo, not the
scratchpad). Converted directly below — no field invented, every writer/reader/line copied from
that doc's own frontmatter.

```yaml
  - concept: restore_type_derivation
    domain: workout
    description: |
      Diagnose b6e1c8 (2026-09-26, day-swapper + sync-load batch, Task 21 fix
      + Task 23 repair): `_restoreScheduledWorkouts` (the REINSTALL restore
      path, independent of `_restoreWorkoutPlan`'s merge) derives a schedule
      row's local `type` from template-resolution / existing-local-type /
      template_id-presence, IGNORING the cloud `status` column entirely — a
      cloud rest day restores as `type: workout` + `status: rest` with no
      exercises (28 confirmed live rows, spec §1.4). `PlanIntegrityReconciler.needsHeal`
      then misreads that hybrid as a workout that lost its exercises (the
      `a7d3f1` repair's exact target shape) and can never self-correct it,
      because healing re-derives exercises for a day that should never have
      been typed `workout`. This is a SEPARATE writer of the identical hybrid
      shape from `d5a1e7`'s `mergeScheduleEntry` fix (this batch's own
      `schedule_arrangement_stamp`/restore-merge L1/L3 work, Task 21) —
      `_restoreScheduledWorkouts` never calls `mergeScheduleEntry`, so fixing
      one does not fix the other; both are fixed in this same batch. The
      shared underlying storage is the SAME `schedule_<date>` row
      `scheduled_workouts_mutations` already owns — this concept documents a
      type-DERIVATION correctness contract on that existing storage, not a
      new Hive key of its own (the empty hive key prefix below is deliberate,
      same reasoning as `schedule_arrangement_stamp`).
    writers:
      - file: lib/core/services/sync/sync_workout.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "_restoreScheduledWorkouts (type derivation ignores cloud status; fixed at ~:2097-2100 by Task 21 to derive type:rest when cloud status=rest and no template resolves)"
      - file: lib/core/services/sync_service.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: "weeklyFullSync (copies the hybrid into the plan_json backup on every daily push -- the reason the bug persists across devices until fixed)"
    reader_manifest_complete: false
    readers:
      - file: lib/core/services/plan_integrity_reconciler.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: needsHeal
        semantic: flag-check
        fields_read: [schedule_<date>.type, schedule_<date>.status, schedule_<date>.exercises]
        notes: "misreads the pre-fix hybrid as a workout that lost its exercises (the a7d3f1 repair's target shape) -- this is the BUG this concept documents, now closed by Task 21's writer-side fix + Task 23's one-time repair of existing rows"
      - file: lib/shared/repositories/plan_engine/plan_engine_flags.dart
        line_range: 1-9999
        method: isRestDayConsideringLogged
        semantic: flag-check
        fields_read: [schedule_<date>.type, schedule_<date>.status]
    regression_test: test/services/schedule_hybrid_repair_migrator_test.dart
    behavioral_test_path: test/services/schedule_hybrid_repair_migrator_test.dart
    behavioral_test_path_invariant: test/sync/restore_merge_invariants_test.dart
    hive:
      box: workoutBox
      key_prefix: ""
      key_formula: "schedule_${formatDateKey(date)} -- the SAME row scheduled_workouts_mutations already owns; this concept pins the type-derivation CORRECTNESS contract on it, not a distinct key"
    cloud:
      table: scheduled_workouts
      columns: [status, type, template_id]
    sync_methods: [weeklyFullSync]
    restore_methods: [_restoreScheduledWorkouts]
    class_constraints: |
      type: rest is derived whenever cloud status=rest AND no template
      resolves for that date -- never falls through to workout/custom_template
      in that case. The one ambiguous pre-existing hybrid that DOES have
      exercises is left untouched by the one-time repair migrator, with a
      telemetry event, rather than guessed at (choosing a winner would be a
      guess, not a fix). The merge-output normalizer (Task 21, D5) closes the
      re-entry path so a fresh restore cannot recreate the hybrid even before
      the one-time repair runs.
```

`hive_key_prefix: ""` is deliberate, not a gap: the diagnose doc's own frontmatter filled
`hive_key_prefix:` with descriptive prose ("schedule_ — the per-date row ...") rather than a bare
`schedule_`, which reads as the same signal `schedule_arrangement_stamp` required — this concept
pins a correctness contract on a prefix `scheduled_workouts_mutations` already owns, not a new
prefix of its own. Using the raw prose value verbatim as a top-level `hive_key_prefix:` would trip
**Gate 9**, since `check_writeservice_contracts.dart`'s emptiness check only special-cases literal
`""`/`''`, not "non-empty but not really a Hive-owning prefix" — it would then require
`test/contracts/restore_type_derivation_writer_to_reader_test.dart` to exist, which nothing in
Task 21/22/23's drafted scope creates (they create/extend
`schedule_hybrid_repair_migrator_test.dart` and `restore_merge_invariants_test.dart`
instead — cited above as `behavioral_test_path`/`behavioral_test_path_invariant`, which satisfies
Gate 42 without ever triggering Gate 9). `reader_manifest_complete: false` for the same reason
`day_swap_engine`'s is false — Gate 50 Phase 2 does not fire without a non-empty `hive.key_prefix`
regardless, so this is the safe conservative default, not a confirmed gap.

**Do NOT duplicate `draft_task_23.md`'s own `reader_allow_files` edit** to the EXISTING
`scheduled_workouts_mutations` concept (its Step 3.5, registry `:436-440`, adds
`lib/core/services/schedule_hybrid_repair_migrator.dart` to that concept's `reader_allow_files:`
list, required for Gate 50 on Task 23's OWN commit) — that edit lands in Task 23's commit, before
Task 29 ever runs, and this draft's Step 2 for `scheduled_workouts_mutations` does not touch

`scripts/check_sync_hash_skip_atomicity.dart`: replace the whole file with:

```dart
// Gate G1 (day-swapper + sync-load batch, spec §7): every Supabase history
// write in the sync layer sits inside SyncSkipIndex.pushIfChanged or an
// allowlisted single-row method; a catch inside a push rethrows or returns
// false; index-key literals live only in sync_skip_index.dart. Logic and
// rationale: scripts/sync_hash_skip_atomicity_lib.dart.
//
// It replaced the OI-204 count-based exlog/nlog check (retired in Task 32,
// when both domains moved onto SyncSkipIndex and the flags it counted no
// longer existed). Hard-fail by default since Task 32, after a 24 h warn-only
// baseline (CLAUDE.md §4.11). `--hard` is still accepted and changes nothing.
import 'dart:io';

import 'sync_hash_skip_atomicity_lib.dart';
import 'sync_no_now_fallback_lib.dart' show isSyncLayerPath;

void main(List<String> args) {
  final structural = checkSyncStructure(_syncLayerSources());
  if (structural.isNotEmpty) {
    stderr.writeln('FAIL sync write structure (G1) — '
        '${structural.length} violation(s):');
    for (final v in structural) {
      stderr.writeln('  $v');
    }
    exit(1);
  }
  print('check_sync_hash_skip_atomicity: OK');
}

Map<String, String> _syncLayerSources() {
  final out = <String, String>{};
  final dir = Directory('lib/core/services/sync');
  if (dir.existsSync()) {
    for (final e in dir.listSync(recursive: true)) {
      if (e is! File) continue;
      final rel = e.path.replaceAll(r'\', '/');
      if (isSyncLayerPath(rel)) out[rel] = e.readAsStringSync();
    }
  }
  final svc = File('lib/core/services/sync_service.dart');
  if (svc.existsSync()) out[svc.path] = svc.readAsStringSync();
  return out;
}
```

(`args` is kept so `--hard` still parses; there is no warn path left, so the runner has no default to flip. The `_syncLayerSources` body is Task 3's, unchanged — re-read it in the file before replacing and keep it byte-identical if it has moved on.)
